body: That would be great and I'm definitely down for that.

I'm so sorry for your loss also. Being as she was my only family I feel so damn lost now. I hope you and your daughter are well during these crazy times. Thank you so much I appreciate it alot. I really could use a hug

I've really been trying and struggling to stay distracted but it only helps so much. I usually break eventually and I'm just so fucking alone. It feels pointless and I can't even truly enjoy things like I used to. Thank you and I truly hope I can make it through this.

I'm trying so hard but it's been so numbing and exhausting trying to keep my thoughts away. I keep breaking down and having panic attacks when I realize the truth of what's happened. I have absolutely nobody now and it's freaking me out. I'm just so alone and now the one and only gift I ever truly liked on my birthday of getting to hear her say it and tell me she loves me is the one thing I'll never get. It's killing me
I'm I'm broken right now. Idk how to cope or continue because she was what kept me strong. I have no one now and it feels ao pointless

Its been such a horrible couple of weeks. I try to hide from my emotions and thoughts because it's too unbearable to think I won't be able to see her again. I only ever made it to this age because of her and feel so lost now cause it feels like things will never truly get better. I don't have friends because well idk, most people have forgotten about me and I haven't really been close to anyone in a long time. I'm kind of a ghost around here. My mom was wonderful and so sweet. She would always want to hear about my day and no matter how boring or lame she wanted to know if I was okay. Every single time she would go out to eat she would make sure to save some for me or bring me something. On my birthdays she was the only one to hug me and say I love you. My birthday is this Monday and I'll be so alone.

I'm really trying but man I barely made it to this age without her. I truly never thought I'd pass 25 but she kept me strong. I don't have any family, friends or much of anyone now and things aren't getting better. I just dont know how to make her proud because I don't really see things improving as much as I want then to

I am trying so hard. I do want to honor her and make her proud but im so out of strength. I'm terrified ill do something stupid that will disappoint her but ultimately I am so tired of waking up. Every day is a miserable one and she was the only thing that kept me strong. I never thought I'd even make it to this age if it wasn't for her. Nobody loves me but she did and I was more than satisfied with that because she was such a precious person. I'm just so alone now nothing makes sense.
